performance_acceptance: Manual operator decision outside helper; no thresholds or automatic deployment conclusion.
remaining_requirements: Independent reviewer checks helper and test changes.
Both real pairs must finish all own planned suites and pass complete exact-output comparisons.
Operator accepts measured performance and verifies stopped service/empty GPUs before explicit execution.
After config replacement, operator starts existing service and verifies actual engine/library/flags/8slots/route; rollback on failure.
limitations: This validates frozen-harness generated reports and runtime identity evidence, not a separate recomputation of all raw output hashes.
The helper does not start, stop, or health-check the service; receipt explicitly leaves service restart pending.
Pending/partial/failed runs or combining partial arms never satisfy the gate.
